dedupe_keys.name: gridded dataset for total water storage estimation in the seine through transfer learning

description: The STARS4Water project and IGME-CSIC publish input layers and monthly total-water-storage-change outputs for the Seine basin in France. Their public README identifies a 48 by 28 cell grid at 0.11 degrees, with 15 static layers, five dynamic layers, TSMP reference outputs and transformer predictions transferred from a Duero model. Files inside the public ZIP are described as multiband GeoTIFF and NetCDF; the grid outputs cover February 2010 to December 2020 in millimetres. The README also names a longer NetCDF source series to December 2022, so the two ranges should not be merged. Zenodo states CC0. A basin water-storage simulation could compare its seasonal changes with the predicted and TSMP reference grids. The README reports test R² of 0.80 and MAE of 14.3 mm, which describe model performance, not observational certainty. A verification limitation is that no archive file was opened; band dates, nodata handling and individual source rights remain to be checked. No related catalogue record identifies this release.
name: Gridded dataset for total water storage estimation in the Seine through transfer learning
